corinthians1.5.p1.b1.text: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans …

corinthians1.5.p1.b2.text: And you are proud! Shouldn’t you rather have been stricken with grief

corinthians1.5.p1.b3.text: and have removed from your fellowship the man who did this?

corinthians1.5.p2.b4.text: Although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit … just as if I were present.

corinthians1.5.p2.b5.text: When you are assembled in the name of our Lord Jesus and I am with you in spirit, along with the power of the Lord Jesus,

corinthians1.5.p2.b6.text: hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord.

corinthians1.5.p3.b7.text: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven works through the whole batch of dough?

corinthians1.5.p3.b8.text: Get rid of the old leaven, that you may be a new unleavened batch, as you really are.

corinthians1.5.p3.b9.text: For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed. Therefore let us keep the feast … with the unleavened bread of sincerity and of truth.

corinthians1.5.p4.b10.text: I wrote you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people.

corinthians1.5.p4.b11.text: I was not including the sexually immoral of this world … In that case you would have to leave this world.

corinthians1.5.p4.b12.text: But now I am writing you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother but is sexually immoral … With such a man do not even eat.

corinthians1.5.p4.b13.text: God will judge those outside. “Expel the wicked man from among you.”
